cut: Immutable completed F4 native birth and F5 bootstrap source packages, with subsequent independent source findings; active join/repair and F6 preparation excluded.

F4.wiring: Six-file source overlay for the same existing caller; unconditional execution refusal retained. Not the final merged candidate.
delta: Replace os.fork/default-SIGXCPU/after-fork-pidfd transition with one same-process native clone3(CLONE_CLEAR_SIGHAND|CLONE_PIDFD), ordinary SIGCHLD and private VM/files/sighand. No extra process/service/supervisor executable.

A real native handled, unblocked SIGXCPU keeps the observing caller alive through borrowed soft6 and restoration. Child handled dispositions become default in kernel before wake; ignored SIGXCPU is refused. AS2GiB/affinity[0,1] are installed before birth; child C makes hard(6,45)/AS2GiB before exact exec.

Original absolute CLOCK_MONOTONIC180 timer is native, not Python-delivered. Before pidfd publication its handler siglongjmps within a restricted C syscall region to rollback+AfterFork_Parent; after publication it uses the kernel-written pidfd even before wrapper return. Pending original deadline cannot be silently consumed and followed by birth.

Kernel failure after put_user but before fd_install is distinguished from successful birth: no close of an unowned stale fd number, original errno preserved, no fallback/retry. A born root PID/handle remains in native state even if Python return raises.

CPython BeforeFork/AfterFork_Parent are paired with GIL/main-thread/main-interpreter/no-foreign-thread checks. Child never re-enters copied Python/libffi/glibc atfork callbacks; direct native exec/_exit avoids AfterFork_Child handler-table mismatch. Native error path writes stage/errno, never repr.

Existing final root wait4 and adopted-child custody/accounting remain in unchanged finite_custody.py. Caller recovers native handle on Python exception, closes partial pipes and invokes native closure after every post-reap result path. Incomplete custody/rollback explicitly remains STOP_UNCONFIRMED, never silently accepted.
F4.mechanism: Conditionally coherent on reviewed source/ABI assumptions; R1/R2 block clean final source judgment.

F5.wiring: Owner/launcher/mode/TraceCustody/GNU shim source joined within F5; F4 final join absent in this immutable package.
delta: Existing once-only owner calls TraceCustody bootstrap then persistent finish, with fallback direct Custody retained before trace/pipe configuration. No separate helper process/credit/manager.

Launcher publishes fixed readiness and waits on owned pipe AFTER its Python exec, before GNU exec; Popen preexec has no barrier. Existing owner installs all inherited SEIZE options atomically before pipe release. GNU exact ELF/argv/providers verified by the source before detach.

GNU fork parent and auto-attached mode initial stop join exact GETEVENTMSG; child-first stops remain quarantined until the event proves their origin. GNU detaches before ordinary native arm while mode stays held before userspace.

GNU-only dynamic shim forwards versioned exact next libc timer/fork/exec functions; it records actual successful original60 POSIX arm or supported original alarm60 fallback. timer_delete2.34 corrected explicitly. No extra timer/native GNU source/duration/process/credit.

Mode first CONT requires ordered exact112B nonce/GNU PID/PPID/api/timer/signal/duration/arm-success record and checks same original deadline/remaining120. Missing/late/failing setup consumes claim and keeps failed bootstrap NOT_RUN, with original-clock exact cleanup; no shorter healthy drain.

Fork-child path removes LD_PRELOAD/allFGNU env and closes writer FD before exact interpreter exec; root checks actual mode exec/mapping and mode checks inherited original owner TracerPid/source joins.

One exclusive wait4 event pump retains raw trace notifications; real parent usage uses actual RUSAGE_CHILDREN increment, caches terminal/released identity before validation, avoids trace/nonleader duplicate charges, retains adopted exact reaps and zero-role UNKNOWN. Genuine signal-delivery GETSIGINFO forwards real signals; group-stop LISTEN separate; no fake trap/foreign thread.

timing_assessment.original180: One original clock, both pre-detach and pre-first-CONT remaining120 checks include bootstrap elapsed; absolute root timer/CPU reservation unchanged.
timing_assessment.successful_arm: The shim samples monotonic AFTER successful unchanged relative60 native arm. Actual start<=recorded success time<=receipt/check; native expiration upper-bound success+60 plus unchanged full60 closure fits original deadline whenever success/check+120<deadline. These source inequalities do not prove actual kernel delivery/latency or elapsed setup margin.
timing_assessment.physical_check_limit: User-space checks are not an atomic scheduler/deadline syscall or a timer reset. Actual arm/order/delivery and owner-stop controls must be qualified on exact final source; delayed/missing readiness aborts instead of borrowing time. Native60 is the original GNU lifetime interval, including startup, not a fresh60 at mode CONT.
timing_assessment.before_detach_owner_stop: Exact control kept: GNU remains before ordinary arm, mode held before userspace; failed bootstrap consumed NOT_RUN, original180 EXITKILL and real permitted terminal/reaps still required. No independent pre-arm GNU60 claim/renamed passing control.
timing_assessment.after_detach: GNU remains untraced so owner cannot gate its SIGALRM delivery. Tracing mode exit still changes GNU normal SIGCHLD/wait ordering; this is explicit and actual controls remain required.
timing_assessment.failure_evidence: Actual owner death before final reaps requires exact existing caller/adoption evidence; EXITKILL/source/JSON alone never proves successful tree/accounting/lock closure.

F5.root_review: Three stale references among76 internal entries (J1).
